name: Camp Scuffy
description_short: Ramapo's full day town camp on a 25 acre property for children entering kindergarten to 9th grade, in three groups: Kindercamp, Scuffy Juniors (grades 1 to 6) and Scuffy Teens (grades 7 to 9). Campers swim daily and go on off site trips; extended day runs to 5:30 pm.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests go in writing to the Parks & Recreation Department; medical refunds need a doctor's note. No refunds once a program has begun, and a $50 per camper surcharge applies to cancellations.

fees.name: Payment plan fee
fees.note: Per family, only for families who choose the payment plan (minimum $500 deposit, in person, started by May 15)

fees.name: Late enrollment increase
fees.note: Charged on new enrollments after June 12, 2026 ($50 for incomplete payment plans)

fees.name: Cancellation surcharge
fees.note: Per camper, charged on a refund for a cancelled camp

notes: Prices are the non-resident rate: $2,050 for kindergarten to grade 6, $2,100 for grades 7 to 9. Ramapo residents pay $1,800 and $1,900. The Registration page gives the Camp Scuffy non-resident upcharge as $250, which would make the teen rate $2,150; the registration form prints $2,100. Non-residents could register from April 13 if space allowed. 9 am to 3:30 pm; extended day 3:30 to 5:30 pm ($300). When checked, Kindercamp was full and grades 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 were waitlist only. Open house for new families was May 17, 2026.
